10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:16cc9378-9c3e-41.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Pricing Manager – AI Trainer (Freelance, 8–20 hrs/week, Remote EU/UK) Are you a seasoned professional in pricing strategy, quantitative analysis, or financial modeling? Are you interested in helping shape the future of artificial intelligence by teaching AI to reason about real-world pricing methodologies? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Pricing Manager AI Trainer and contribute your expertise to advanced AI education—flexibly, remotely, and on your schedule. About Us 10x Team connects freelance professionals with leading AI labs to develop next-generation AI models. We are seeking Pricing Managers based in the EU or UK to ensure AI-generated outputs meet the practical standards and nuanced decision-making expected in industry. Key Responsibilities: - Review and enhance AI-generated content related to pricing strategy, margin analysis, and competitive positioning - Evaluate the realism, relevance, and analytical rigor of pricing methodologies proposed by AI - Draft example scenarios, case studies, and calculations using your pricing expertise - Create scenario variations reflecting viewpoints such as pricing analysts, business managers, and clients - Identify flawed assumptions, unrealistic pricing models, or compliance gaps and provide clear, actionable feedback In essence: You will use your pricing experience to help AI better understand and reason about effective, robust pricing strategies and frameworks. About You: - Senior Pricing Manager or similar, with hands-on experience in pricing, financial modeling, or analytics - Based in the EU or UK - Demonstrated expertise in reviewing pricing strategies, conducting margin analysis, and implementing pricing controls - Highly organized and able to communicate direct, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week with reliable, timely responses Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance work—100% remote - Use your industry expertise to build smarter AI systems - Direct impact: teach AI about complex pricing challenges and approaches - Free access to our AI Academy for upskilling - Structured onboarding, clear briefs, ongoing collaborative projects How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the future of AI-driven pricing analysis—apply today! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d20fbbc6-59d.title: Trainer - Learning and Development Specialist
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:d20fbbc6-59d.description: Wing helps small businesses, startups, executives, and enterprises streamline their operations by providing access to top-tier remote talent. You’ll run classes and training sessions; assess competency; and loop feedback between Instructional Design and QA/OPS to keep content sharp.
responsibilities: New-hire onboarding for Virtual Assistants: Run daily Google Meet classes covering Wing policies, professionalism, data privacy, security, time-tracking, and client etiquette.
Tool bootcamps: live demos and walkthroughs for common client tools: Calendly, Calendar, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, ClickUp/Asana, CRM basics, Notion/Airtable; assign hands-on tasks etc.
Client-readiness drills: email/chat tone practice, communication style, meeting notes, task intake, follow-ups, and escalation paths; use Wing examples and templates.
SOP to action: translate client SOPs into step-by-step checklists; run simulated tickets/requests and score with a rubric.
Quality calibration with QA: score sample work, align standards (accuracy, turnaround time, formatting), and brief VAs on common defects.
Professionalism & reliability: coach punctuality, shift handover, calendar hygiene, status updates, and expectation setting with clients.
Systems compliance: verify VA setup (internet speed, power backup plan, headset/cam, workspace), security (2FA, password manager), and confidentiality acknowledgments.
LMS progression: enroll cohorts, gate modules, check completion, and remediate gaps before client endorsement.
Readiness sign-off: run quick quizzes and practicals; record scores; issue pass/hold with clear action items and deadlines.
Account-specific enablement: coordinate with OPS/Future SMEs to deliver short modules on client tools, workflows, and KPIs before deployment.
Performance follow-through: host week-1 and week-2 check-ins post-deployment; review QA feedback and schedule refreshers as needed.
Reporting: send weekly cohort report (attendance, pass rates, readiness risks, remediation plan) and track time-to-productivity metrics.
Feedback loop to instructional design: log confusing content, missing steps, or outdated screenshots; propose fixes and retest after updates.
qualifications: 2-4+ years in live training/facilitation, L&D, BPO coaching, or training enablement
Experience with assessing trainees, bridging gaps between instructional design and operational issues like Churn/escalation types
Clear, confident communicator; English neutral accent and strong pacing
Skilled at group management, cold-calling participants, and keeping sessions engaging
Comfortable with LMS (Thinkific or similar), Google Workspace, Zoom/Meet tools
Can assess performance with rubrics, give actionable feedback, and document results
Organized and reliable across time zones; thrives in fast iterations

Our partner is looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Skylar Analytics based in United States. This is a remote senior product leadership opportunity focused on building and scaling an enterprise analytics and reporting product. You will own the product vision and roadmap across data access, modeling, reporting, and query capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of product, data engineering, data science, and enterprise BI. You will help customers turn complex operational telemetry into accessible, actionable business insights. Your work will reduce time-to-value through ready-to-use connectors, data structures, and reporting templates. You will also shape anomaly detection, predictive alerting, data integrations, and future AI-powered capabilities. Define and deliver connectors, data structures, and reporting templates for platforms such as Power BI and Superset, helping customers access operational data without requiring custom development. Partner with the broader product organization to define and maintain data pipeline contracts, including data scope, fidelity, and evolution as connected products develop. Identify opportunities to strengthen shared data infrastructure and enable analytics data to support emerging agentic AI capabilities. Lead go-to-market strategy, including positioning, packaging, messaging, and the customer narrative that establishes the analytics offering as a compelling standalone product. Partner with sales, marketing, engineering, and other stakeholders to translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value and measurable business outcomes. Use customer feedback, product data, and market insights to prioritize enhancements and continuously improve adoption, usability, and time-to-value. Requirements: 5+ years of Product Management experience focused on reporting, analytics, business intelligence, or a closely related data product, with a demonstrated history of delivering accessible dashboards and reporting solutions. Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, OLAP cubes, schema design, analytical architectures, and query-performance tradeoffs. Hands-on SQL proficiency, with the ability to write queries, inspect data, and validate assumptions independently. Familiarity with modern data-stack technologies such as ClickHouse, dbt, data warehouses, and analytical data pipelines. Experience with BI platforms such as Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable enterprise reporting tools. Working knowledge of data science and machine-learning concepts, particularly anomaly detection and ML pipelines, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical specialists. Experience leading go-to-market initiatives for technical products and translating complex platform capabilities into compelling customer benefits. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and an understanding of the operational and architectural considerations they involve. Experience using Jira Software for product planning and collaboration. Strong communication, prioritization, stakeholder-management, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, data, sales, and marketing teams. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:efe71c95-f3c5-4e4.description: ABOUT FREEFLOW Freeflow is building AI Agents for P&C Insurance Carriers. We’re starting by solving a customer problem that has strong pull from our industry contacts: Claims auditing. Today, carriers audit a small percentage of claims. They do these audits manually, inconsistently, and often too late to drive meaningful outcomes on key business metrics like Loss Ratio, Customer Satisfaction, or Claims Capacity. We believe the future is: → Continuous, AI-driven audits across 100% of claims → Real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities → Direct, measurable improvement to the loss ratio But claims audits are just the starting point. Our broader vision is to build an AI-native operating layer for insurance carriers, that includes: - Submission intake: structuring and routing risk data at the quote stage - Premium audits: ensuring accuracy between exposure and written premium at the bind stage - Claims audits: real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities at the claim stage Having even two out of the three nodes allows Freeflow to create an intelligent data layer powered by AI agents that continuously improves decision-making across the carrier’s operations. This is how we move the loss ratio at scale. AS A FOUNDING PRODUCT MANAGER AT FREEFLOW YOU WILL - You will work directly with founders, customers, and engineers to define what we build, why we build it, and how it creates real economic value (eg improving loss ratios, replacing offshore teams, improving capacity, etc) - This is a 0→1 role where you will define how AI agents: - Understand the world of insurance through modeling industry ontologies - Understand and integrate with our various carrier customers’ systems and SOPs - Review specific data structures (claims files, policies, submissions) - Generate actionable intelligence based on core data to create both efficiency gains and learning opportunities for our carrier customers - Work directly with carriers - Engage claims leaders, audit teams, and executives - Translate real-world pain into shipped product quickly ABOUT YOU - Technical - Leverage yourself and the product org with AI - Interviewing users, SMEs and documenting + transmitting learnings across org - Modeling requirements - Prioritizing efforts in alignment with business strategy - Managing backlogs, feature prioritization - Close collaboration with product design - Given the carrier customers (SOC2, RBAC, SSO, data partitioning), understand enterprise security and compliance requirements. - Collaborate on product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and go-to-market decisions. - Partner directly with engineers to break down product requirements into actionable specs. You'll own the "what" and "why," collaborate on the "how," and be close enough to implementation details to unblock decisions quickly. - Cultural - Passionate about solving customer needs and love moving fast. You are excited about the opportunity to be the primary AI/agent specialist on a small, high-ownership engineering team - You can demonstrate experience with solving open-ended problems in startups at the earliest stage (0 to 1) and you are - able to independently identify critical problems to deliver on key customer needs, propose and implement solutions to those problems - able to structure and execute your own work with little to no supervision BONUS - Deep experience in P&C insurance claims or claims auditing - Comfort working large unstructured data files (documents, notes, images, video, audio, tasks) Note, we don’t expect you to know everything listed above. titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:9b3435f8-30e1.description: VICE PRESIDENT - M&A About Titan Titan is building an AI-native platform for the $300B managed IT services market, acquiring leading managed service providers (MSPs) and deploying AI agents across service desk, security, networking, server administration, and back-office operations. Today, Titan’s agents autonomously perform over 5,000 operational actions per day across customer environments. The company has raised over $90M from investors including General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, and today employs more than 350 IT professionals across its platform companies. Our team brings together AI product expertise from Scale AI, Google, MIT, and Stanford with private equity experience from H.I.G. Capital and seasoned MSP executives who have led some of the industry’s top providers. Joining Titan means helping to redefine how work is done in IT Services and building a $100B company. About the Role We’re looking for a Vice President to help drive Titan’s acquisition strategy - from sourcing and evaluating potential MSP targets to supporting due diligence, deal execution, and integration planning. You’ll work closely with our leadership team and investors to identify high-quality acquisition opportunities, model their impact, and ensure smooth transitions post-close. We aim to close 20+ deals a year. What You’ll Do - Identify, source, and build relationships with target MSPs and adjacent service providers. - Support the full deal lifecycle - from initial outreach through closing and integration. - Conduct detailed financial analysis, market research, and valuation modeling. - Coordinate due diligence across financial, legal, operational, and technical workstreams. - Prepare investment memos and materials for leadership and board review. - Collaborate with operations and product teams to ensure seamless post-acquisition integration. - Maintain and refine Titan’s acquisition pipeline, tracking key deal metrics. Who You Are - 3+ of experience as an associate or vp level role at a top PE firm. - Opinionated and self driven - Bonus: experience in IT services, SaaS, or roll-up strategies. This role offers a $225K–$350K salary, along with a generous equity package.

voyfai-voyfai:ashbyhq:02c305f6-a193-4038.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Technology & Product (m/f/d)
voyfai-voyfai:ashbyhq:02c305f6-a193-4038.description: Join Voyfai, a fast-growing Series A startup shaping the future of logistics and technology across Europe. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the centre of a broader group of companies active across several European markets. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping processes, building strategies or leading initiatives, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you. YOUR ROLE We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Technology & Product (m/f/d) to join our TA team and own hiring across Engineering and Product at Voyfai. You will work closely with Cam (Talent Acquisition Senior Manager) and be the go-to recruiter for our technical hiring managers, running searches end-to-end from kick-off to offer. This is an in-house role with real ownership. You will not be coordinating; you will be recruiting. You will build pipelines, assess candidates, run structured processes, and close strong hires in a competitive market. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles: sourcing, screening, managing the process, and closing - Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and run sharp, structured kick-offs - Build and maintain proactive pipelines for technical profiles, particularly AI and software engineering - Assess candidates rigorously and give structured, well-reasoned feedback at every stage - Use AI tools and automation to move faster: sourcing with Juicebox, writing and research with Claude or ChatGPT, candidate insights with AshbyAI, and workflow automation across Notion and other tools - Contribute to TA process improvements, tooling, and employer brand initiatives - Work within Ashby and maintain clean, up-to-date pipeline data at all times WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of in-house recruiting experience, with a strong focus on Engineering and Product roles - Experience across at least two companies, ideally across different growth stages (Series B and Series D+) - Proven track record hiring software engineers and product managers in competitive European markets - Experience hiring AI or ML engineers is a strong plus - Comfort running structured, competency-based interview processes end-to-end - Sharp written and verbal communication; you write candidate feedback that hiring managers actually trust - A habit of using AI tools and automation in your daily work, not occasionally but as default. You know how to use Claude, ChatGPT, Juicebox, AshbyAI or similar tools to move faster and do better work - Berlin-based - Fluency in English; German is a plus BONUS IF YOU HAVE - Experience at a logistics, freight, or supply chain company - Worked with Ashby or a similarly modern ATS - Built or improved recruiting processes from scratch in a scaling team WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive salary and equity options - A dynamic, fast-paced work environment with a mission-driven team - Flexible working arrangements (Hybrid) - 30 days of PTO - Regular team events and offsites - Monthly mobility budget via Navit
